newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt paper yields mixed, interbank rates easier.
newsitem.headline: HK govt paper yields mixed, interbank rates easier.

text.p: Hong Kong government paper yields were mixed on Wednesday while interbank rates were slightly easier, dealers said.
Three-year note yields eased to 6.17 percent from 6.19 at Tuesday midday, five-year note yields remained the same at 6.66 percent, and seven-year note yields rose to 6.89 from 6.87.

Yields of one-week bills dropped to 4.19 percent from 4.48 at Tuesday midday. The drop was due to a major Hong Kong bank buying back a large quantity of bills after selling on Tuesday, a local bank dealer said.
Interbank rates were slightly easier. The overnight rate was down a hair to 5-5/16 1/4 percent from 5-1/2 7/16 at Tuesday midday. Three-month money was at 5-7/16 3/8 versus 5-9/16 1/2.
